Class VariantProviderBase

java.lang.Object
org.moddingx.libx.datagen.provider.RegistryProviderBase
org.moddingx.libx.datagen.provider.sandbox.VariantProviderBase
All Implemented Interfaces:
RegistryProvider
public abstract class VariantProviderBase extends RegistryProviderBase
SandBox provider for the entity variant registries, such as cat variants or cow variants. This provider must run in the registry setup stage.

    • variant

      public <T> net.minecraft.core.Holder<T> variant(net.minecraft.resources.ResourceKey<? extends net.minecraft.core.Registry<T>> registry, T variant)
      Registers an arbitrary value to the given registry. This can be used for variant registries that have no dedicated factory method in this provider. This method returns an intrusive holder that must be properly added to the registry. RegistryProviderBase does this automatically if the result is stored in a public, non-static field inside the provider.

    • spawnNever

      public static net.minecraft.world.entity.variant.SpawnPrioritySelectors spawnNever()
      Spawn conditions that never match. A variant with these conditions is never chosen for a naturally spawning entity, it can only be obtained explicitly, for example through commands.

    • spawnAlways

      public static net.minecraft.world.entity.variant.SpawnPrioritySelectors spawnAlways(int priority)
      Spawn conditions that always match with the given priority. Used by vanilla with priority 0 for the default variant of an entity.

    • spawnWhen

      public static net.minecraft.world.entity.variant.SpawnPrioritySelectors spawnWhen(net.minecraft.world.entity.variant.SpawnCondition condition, int priority)
      Spawn conditions matching a single condition with the given priority. Of all variants whose conditions match, one with the highest priority is chosen at random.
